sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Early Chapter carried Metal, the energy of Expression, into a chart that pulled against it. As a child you talked back, tested every rule and wanted everything at once. With an older relative who heard you out before answering, you learned when to speak and when to wait.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Under it ran Earth, which kept feeding the Metal, and the weight on you came back as fast as you shed it.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth, a strength your chart was short of, with games and teams at school. You learned early that you could hold your own among other children.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth through children your age who wanted the same toys and the same turn. You learned to stand up for your share, and you never quite stopped.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Rising Chapter carried Metal, the energy of Expression, against the grain of your chart. Between your late teens and mid-thirties you spoke first, spent freely and chafed at every rule you had not written. Finishing one thing before you started the next carried you, and you left those years knowing which fights deserved your voice.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Under it ran Wood, and the Metal wore part of its force away holding it down, and you took less of the weight.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Fire through study, a course or a training that finally fitted. You gained a way of thinking that you still use.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Home Chapter · now · Metal, Expression, release
sections.text: Your Home Chapter carries Metal, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties, appetite and opinion have filled the house, and a partner has borne the brunt of your restlessness. An hour of quiet each evening settles it, and you are learning to let them have the last word.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS

sections.head: WORKING WITH IT

sections.head: DECADE

sections.text: Under it runs Wood, which the Metal holds down, and you have firm footing for every use of the gift.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Career, this chapter favours a role with clear duties over a free hand, and what you promise and deliver earns you a name for being reliable.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: With friends, this chapter favours people who turn up on time over people who keep you amused, and you gain standing in groups that have a purpose.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours set routines over loose ones, and what you decide becomes the way the household runs.

sections.head: WORKING WITH IT
sections.text: This chapter gives your strength the shape it has lacked. Clear roles and firm deadlines bring out your best, and you rise when someone holds you to a standard.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Water, more Mind than your chart can use, with plans that stay plans and help you never asked for. You think a step too long before each move. You find your footing by doing one thing at a time, and the plans start to move.

sections.head: DECADE · UNDERNEATH
sections.text: Under it runs Earth, pushing back against the Water all the while, and the strain on you loosens its grip.

sections.head: DECADE FAVOURS
sections.text: Getting outside over another day indoors

sections.head: DECADE FAVOURS

sections.head: DECADE FAVOURS

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Water as advice you never asked for, from people who mean well. You trust your own reading of things after a walk on your own clears the noise.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Home Chapter · coming · Earth, Action, grow
sections.text: Your Home Chapter carries Earth, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take on the house as a project of your own, and the effort shows in every corner of it.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Love, this chapter favours practical care over fine words, but you show love best through the things you fix and pay for.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Wealth, this chapter favours putting money to work over letting it sit, and what you plant pays back more than what you save.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours shared plans over private ones, and you run the household as a joint venture.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Wood beyond what your chart needs, a grip that holds on harder than the moment asks. You spend the surplus on a long walk each evening, before it can turn into a quarrel.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · coming · Earth, Action, grow
sections.text: Your Late Chapter carries Earth, the energy of Action, and your chart still wants it. From your late forties new chances keep coming within reach, and the people after you bring many of them. You pick the few that matter and make them pay.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · coming · Earth, Action, grow
sections.text: Under it runs Wood, which pushes back against the Earth at every step, but you have to work for each share of the gift.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Career, this chapter favours work that pays as it goes over work that pays at the end, and you keep more than one thing running at once.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: With friends, this chapter favours saying yes to the invitation over staying in, and the people you meet in passing open doors you could not open alone.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Wood with a habit of holding on to your own way at home. You find a slower answer eases it, and a draw at home is worth more to you than a win.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Fire and the pleasure of showing someone younger how a thing is made. You teach with your hands as much as your words, and the lessons stick.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: This decade brings Fire as an appetite for new tastes, new places and an evening out without a reason. You say yes to the invitation and come home with a story to tell.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Fire brings Expression for a whole year, a voice your chart welcomes. What you make and say lands where you aim it, with pleasure in the making as well as the result.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: A small resentment grows at home this year without a word said, and the quiet costs you ease in the place you rest.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Fire brings Expression for a second year running, and the outlet stays open. A skill you kept for pleasure begins to pay its way, while new work comes faster than last year's did.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You change something at home this year, an address or the way the household runs, and the change asks for your patience while it beds in.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Earth brings Action for a whole year, reach your chart welcomes. Your effort pays back promptly, as practical plans move at the speed you set.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You leave a role or a team you have outgrown this year, by your own choice or by theirs, with everything you learned there going with you.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Earth brings Action for a second year running, and the reach holds. A plan you started last year pays its way, which gives you the footing to widen it with care.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: A quiet coolness settles this year between you and an older relative, and each visit costs you an effort.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Metal brings Order for a whole year, structure your chart welcomes. You take on a role with clear edges, the kind where others know what to bring you.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: Home tests you this year with small frictions that grind on, and the patience they take comes out of your own reserve.

sections.head: YEAR
sections.text: Metal brings Order for a second year running, and the frame holds. Last year's duties settle into habit, but you still give the newer parts of the role your full attention.

sections.head: YEAR · LANDS
sections.text: You bind yourself to a workplace or a team this year, by contract or by loyalty, and its plans start to include you.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Earth, Body, grow
sections.text: Your Early Chapter carried Earth, your own energy, when your chart was thin on it. Up to fifteen, children your age gave you someone to keep up with, in games you had to push your way into. You came out of that first home steadier on your own feet than you began.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Early Chapter · lived · Earth, Body, grow
sections.text: Under it ran Earth too, doubling the gift, and you had the whole of it to use.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Wood as strict rules and grown-ups who were quick to correct you. You kept a corner of calm that belonged to you, a quiet place no one else corrected.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Fire through study, a course or a training that finally fitted. You gained a way of thinking that you still use.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Wood, Order, release
sections.text: Your Rising Chapter carried Wood, the energy of Order, and your chart chafed against it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties work came with tight rules and managers who watched closely, and bending to fit cost you more than you showed. With loyal friends to keep you level, you came out able to stand firm under pressure.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Rising Chapter · lived · Wood, Order, release
sections.text: Under it ran Wood of the same kind, one strain from top to bottom, but you learned its shape by heart.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Fire, a stretch of shelter with someone who backed you and asked little in return. You let yourself be helped and found that it cost you nothing.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Home Chapter · lived · Earth, Body, grow
sections.text: Your Home Chapter carried Earth, your own energy, when your chart ran short of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties a partner met you as an equal, and the household made you sturdier. You learned to lean on yourself first and on others by choice.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth and the company of equals, colleagues and friends who matched your pace. You found a firmness in yourself that had been missing before.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Earth, a stretch when you stopped waiting for permission. You struck out on your own terms and held your position against people who doubted you.

sections.head: CHAPTER
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · now · Wood, Order, release
sections.text: Your Late Chapter carries Wood, the energy of Order, and your chart wants less of it. Since your late forties you have been the one held responsible, for what you built and for how the people after you turn out. You turn down the smaller claims, and there is freedom in no longer having the final word.

sections.head: UNDERNEATH
sections.sub: The Late Chapter · now · Wood, Order, release
sections.text: Under it runs Wood as well, a pull at both levels, but you find no softer layer underneath.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: At home, this chapter favours letting small things slide over keeping every standard, but you relax in a house that forgives a little mess.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Career, this chapter favours one commitment over several, but you do your best with fewer people to answer to.

sections.head: WHERE IT LANDS
sections.text: In Health, this chapter favours rest over endurance, and you recover faster when you stop proving you can take the strain.

sections.head: WORKING WITH IT
sections.text: This chapter bears down on you from outside. You carry it best with something of your own it cannot reach, a friend, a slower pace or a quiet place.

sections.head: DECADE
sections.text: These years brought Metal to the family table as a sharp tongue, with opinions that arrived before anyone asked. You kept your welcome by letting the people after you finish their sentences.
